t: This is Murano, a restaurant in Mayfair. It opened in August 2008, started by chefs Angela Hartnett and Gordon Ramsay. In October 2010 Hartnett bought it outright from Ramsay, and she has owned it since. She is a protégée of Ramsay, and she's also the chef-patron of the Café Murano restaurants elsewhere in London. Murano won a Michelin star in 2009 and has kept it ever since, so you're standing outside a restaurant with a long-standing reputation for its cooking.
